bootstrap_class_support: Recall is averaged over target classes present in each draw, identically for every cell; one-class draws are retained and counted.
uncertainty: Percentile subject-cluster bootstrap conditional on the single pretraining seed, fixed folds and fitted readers. One draw per dataset is shared by all cells and readout seeds; datasets are resampled independently. MLP BAcc is the mean of two fixed readout seed scores, not an ensemble or resampling of training seeds. No multiple-comparison correction and no adoption gate.
